**Why D = 1 is exact here (and where it is not).** When the growth law is

`N_i = G/dP_i^m` with `G = int da/(C f^m)`, so
`D = sum n_i dP_i^m / G` telescopes to exactly 1 for any block order and any
number of blocks.
